name: Formatter
scope: Indentation and outer whitespace; preserves tokens and comments.

name: Parser recovery
scope: Up to 20 errors at top-level line boundaries.

name: Optional types
scope: Bounded checking, Arya module contracts and declaration output.

name: Editor references, rename and signatures
scope: Snapshot/open-document analysis; incomplete public renames are refused.

name: Incremental project builds
scope: Contained graph builds with bounded compilation reuse.

name: Closed-file workspace analysis
scope: Discovery, cached dependency analysis and static namespace rename.

name: Mutation and control-flow checking
scope: Declared versus flow types, branch joins, loop writes and conservative capture invalidation.

name: npm declaration imports
scope: Bounded named/default/CommonJS exports and non-generic overloads.

name: Standard testing library
scope: Node-backed suites, hooks, assertions and mocks.

name: Standard security library
scope: Password hashing, tokens, HMAC and authenticated encryption.

name: Node editor debugging
scope: Arya source breakpoints, local inspection and stepping; requires a Node adapter and per-editor/platform qualification.

name: Exact accounting batches
scope: Bounded invoice/ledger library with portable BigInt, optional native kernel and exact strings; no ISO currency registry or standalone compiler.

name: Native scalar executable preview
scope: Shared frontend, verified typed IR and host LLVM executable for annotated scalar functions; broader language/runtime and platform qualification remain incomplete.

name: Persistent Python worker
scope: Current calls and batches use fresh child processes.

name: Unicode identifiers and bidi editing
scope: Needs a separately reviewed language/editor proposal.
